summary: Compile architecture-neutral frontend assets on the native build runner while keeping runtime tools aligned with each target image platform.
security: The final nginx image and its BusyBox runtime tools are still resolved and installed for the requested target platform.
documentation: This release note records the native frontend compilation and target-platform runtime boundary; no operator procedure changes.
knownLimitations: Final target-platform package installation still uses QEMU when no native arm64 runner is available, but frontend compilation no longer does.
rollback: Revert the Dockerfile stage-platform change to compile frontend assets on the target platform.
validation: A Dockerfile contract test enforces native frontend compilation and target-platform runtime executable installation.
The release canary exercises both amd64 and arm64 images before public aliases are permitted.
